sql:
SELECT
    toMonth(DateKey) AS month,
    sum(SalesAmount) AS monthly_sales,
    neighbor(sum(SalesAmount), -1) OVER (ORDER BY toMonth(DateKey)) AS prev_month_sales,
    round(
        (sum(SalesAmount) - neighbor(sum(SalesAmount), -1) OVER (ORDER BY toMonth(DateKey)))
        / nullIf(neighbor(sum(SalesAmount), -1) OVER (ORDER BY toMonth(DateKey)), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
